scope: Full tracked checkout; targeted static review of issue model, role contracts, common create/update/claim/ready-claim/heartbeat/reclaim/close/edge bodies, Dolt SQL/history retry ordering, selected embedded/HTTP callers, journal/auth posture, molecule advancement and MCP claim forwarding, with selected conformance and wire-mapping assertions. Not every-line audit, full storage-driver/replication/migration/import/repair/integration/runtime equivalence certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Attempt-local validation/configuration/ID and parent/dependency wiring in transaction; guarded create refuses skipped edges; persistence plane determines history/recovery contract
lifecycle_review.select: Shared readiness SQL and priority/age filters; claim-next selects, claims and hydrates within one transaction; named claim checks status/assignment without querying readiness
lifecycle_review.claim: CAS on lifecycle row token with actor/pool eligibility, durable lease grant and events/version; same-actor retry is no-op without TTL extension; actor asserted rather than authenticated
lifecycle_review.progress: Typed patches with optional revision/status/assignee preconditions and transfer/notes/template checks; merge operations resolved inside transaction; no required execution attempt token
lifecycle_review.review: Acceptance text and selected CLI gate conditions plus child/blocker policy; no qualified reviewer/evidence revision contract; CLI conditions not universal role/API policy
lifecycle_review.complete: Checked close guards template/pin/holder, children/direct blockers and optional revision, deletes lease and versions/recomputes; generic done status patch omits pin/holder guards; force and auto-close molecule boundaries explicit
lifecycle_review.cancel: Task reopen/unclaim/reclaim restore workflow state; no worker process cancellation or external-effect compensation
lifecycle_review.recover: Node-local TTL lease heartbeat/re-arm and guarded reclaim, provenance-aware replica policy with permissive unnamed default, optional row-token stale-write guards, known-rollback retries and indeterminate-commit refusal, durable journal checkpoint/truncation mapping; SQL task durability distinct from later Dolt history publication
